_comment: List every rig control node whose channel-box attributes drive the face.
ArkKit captures each control's keyable / settable / unlocked / numeric
attributes when you press 'Set Defaults', and records per-expression
You can edit this list by hand, or use the 'Add Selected -> Controls'
button in the tool to append whatever is currently selected in Maya.
Names may be short ('jaw_ctrl') or namespaced ('rig:jaw_ctrl').
